title: 第94章 我要让他永世不得超生

content_zh: 燕王府。唐逸进了房间后，便没有出来过。一直到第二天半夜，他才从房间中走来。此时的他头发凌乱，衣衫不整，眼睛更是像被人狠狠揍了两拳，又红又肿，看上去狼狈不堪。但是，他脸上却看不到半点困倦，依旧神采奕奕，透着自信和淡淡的冷漠。“呃，你……你这样子确定死不了吧？”萧棣已经围了过来。目光上下打量了一下唐逸，他都不由下意识咽了咽口水：“靠，兄弟你这也太拼了吧？为那狗皇帝这么拼命不值得啊！”唐逸嘴角抽了抽，白了萧棣一眼：“就算那是你爹，但你天天狗皇帝挂在嘴边，早晚得被砍了。”“还有……谢了！”唐逸由衷感谢。萧棣现在的情况和他其实差不多，都是胡子拉碴，长发凌乱，连身上穿的长袍也都还是之前穿的那身。显然，他这两日都在遵守约定，半步都没有离开过院子。萧棣抬手挠挠头，你这么说我怪不好意思的。“其实，我这么做不全是为了你爹，我是为了自保。”唐逸抬手指了指身后的麻袋，道：“这就是我的秘密武器，把麻袋背上，我们去一趟沈园外，找个风水好一点的地方，埋葬暗京楼的杀手。”他对沈园的地形不熟悉，需要先勘察下地形，找一个最合适的地方作埋伏。萧棣当时就震惊了，真有秘密武器？我还以为你是在做样子给我爹看而已呢。再说你那些瓶瓶罐罐木头水银什么的，能做出什么秘密武器出来？他带着疑惑和好奇立即进了房间，打开麻袋看了一眼……结果，瓶瓶罐罐还是瓶瓶罐罐，要说不同之处，那就是唐逸将他们乱七八糟的组合起来了。瓶瓶罐罐组合在一起，就成了秘密武器？！“呃，兄弟，不是我不相信啊，可你这真是秘密武器？”萧棣睨着唐逸，我读书是不多，但你也别把老子当傻子啊！“是武器，这里面的随便一颗炸弹，就能让你粉身碎骨，你想不想试试？”唐逸眯着眼睛，眼底寒光闪烁。前世他可是西北理工高材生直接进入军队的，做几颗炸弹对他来说轻而易举，再加上在部队和执行任务期间，总共做炸弹的次数加起来，估计都得有八千次了！早就熟练透了！所以现在他连试验都不用，就知道这些炸弹绝对能爆！要是袋子中的百十枚炸弹一起爆，整个燕王府乃至周边民房都得被夷为平地。萧棣从唐逸身上嗅到危险的气息，下意识夹了夹腿，总感觉这家伙是在找机会报复自己啊！算了，事关传宗接代的大事，还是不要试了，万一真炸蛋了，那就扯淡了。“咳，那还是不用了，我还是等着看你怎么炸暗京楼的蛋吧！”萧棣将麻袋扛在肩上。一麻袋的秘密武器足有一百多斤，让唐逸自己背？呵呵，他走不出三里地就得吐血。哎，都怪老子太善良。他看着麻袋走上前，抬手揽住唐逸的腰杆。唐逸当即就像是触电一般跳了起来：“你干嘛？我对男人可没兴趣。”“哦，那你就慢慢走着去沈园吧！”萧棣瞥了唐逸一眼，不识好人心。他脚在地上一踏，整个人瞬间凌空飞起，再在空中凌空一翻，轻松掠出燕王府。唐逸：“？？”妈的，作弊啊！老子用走的，你用飞的？！从燕王府到沈园，足有二十里地，走到沈园天都亮了好吧！而且现在暗京楼在盯着他，走夜路不安全。“老萧，有话好说。”“我觉得男人还是不错的，咱哥们就别那么客气了。”唐逸大叫着连忙追了出去。……翌日，唐家。一大早，唐家变已经热闹起来了。唐家大厅，唐敬，颜霜玉母子，以及姜云娜，全都已经在汇聚在这里，为唐画鼓劲。主位上，唐敬喝着唐画敬的茶，看着站在眼前谦谦君子温润如玉的儿子，他脸上满是欣慰和满意。“庆功宴的事，不必在意，那不过是你前进路上的一个小小挫折罢了。”当初唐逸大闹庆功宴，让唐家丢了很大的脸，唐敬怕这件事影响到唐画，笑着开导他。“今日，你只要拿出和殿试时的心态，你就赢了。”“无论如何，都要力压全场，为你，为唐家正名。”唐逸大闹庆功宴后，如今成了京都的笑柄，连同当年他唐敬宠妾灭妻的事，再一次被搬了出来。现在，他需要唐画在沈园诗会夺魁，来证明自己当初的选择没有错。唐画，才是他唐逸精心培养出来的继承人。而唐逸，不过是和他有点血脉关系的废物罢了！“父亲放心，孩儿必定不会让父亲失望。”唐画拱手行礼，恭敬说道。他此时低着头，没人看清他的脸色，谁都没有注意到他此时脸色狰狞至极，眼中的寒意几乎都要溢出来了。唐逸，等着吧，你带给我的屈辱，今日，我会千倍万倍地还给你！“老爷，你就放心吧，画儿这段时间可认真了，一直都在他书房读书呢。”颜霜玉走了出来，看着自己英俊不凡的儿子也是非常的满意：“画儿是三元及第的状元，今日夺魁，恐怕京都无数姑娘，都惦记着画儿呢。”“别说孔家小姐，就是公主，也不是娶不得。”姜云娜眼睛偷偷瞥了一眼唐画，脸颊渐渐泛红。公主算什么？画哥哥只能是我的，如此优秀的儿郎，除了我姜云娜，谁配？唐逸还想和画哥哥比，哼，萤火也敢和太阳争辉？可笑至极！这几日，她原本想直接对唐逸用强，然后诬陷唐逸，只可惜他一直躲在燕王府，一直没有机会。否则，他这时候早身败名裂了！“那是，我哥如今可是京都第一才子，比那藏头露尾的小诗仙，不知道强多少倍呢。”唐浩也是满脸谄媚，挥动拳头恭维。站在唐浩身侧的林竹，也是嘴角带笑。唐逸大闹庆功宴为唐音出头，京都都知道她是个恶妇，今天这种日子，是她洗刷耻辱正名的机会，岂会错过？只要唐画夺魁，为她说两句话，将所有罪名都推给唐逸，京都谁还敢嚼她舌根？“娘，二弟，别胡说，京都还是有很多有名的才子的。”唐画很享受这种恭维，面上却装着责备。“切，什么才子学子，早就是哥你的手下败将了！”唐浩靠近唐画，道：“哥，记住了，今日一定要让唐逸身败名裂，将他打进十八层地狱。”“我，要让他永世不得超生！”
content_en: Prince Yan's Mansion.After Tang Yi entered the room, he never came out.It wasn't until midnight the next day that he came out of the room.At this time, his hair was messy, his clothes were disheveled, and his eyes looked like they had been punched hard twice. They were red and swollen, and he looked miserable.However, there was no trace of sleepiness on his face, he was still full of energy, showing confidence and a touch of indifference."Uh, you...are you sure you can't die like this?" Xiao Di had already gathered around.Looking Tang Yi up and down, he couldn't help but swallowed subconsciously: "Damn, brother, you are working too hard, aren't you? It's not worth working so hard for that dog emperor!" Tang Yi twitched the corner of his mouth and rolled his eyes at Xiao Di: "Even if that is your father, if you talk about the dog emperor every day, sooner or later, you will be chopped off." "And... thank you!" Tang Yi thanked him sincerely.Xiao Di's current situation is actually similar to him. He is unshaven, has messy long hair, and even the robe he is wearing is still the same as before.Obviously, he had been keeping his promise for the past two days and had not left the yard even half a step.Xiao Di raised his hand and scratched his head, "I'm sorry you said that.""Actually, I'm not doing this all for your father, I'm doing it to protect myself." Tang Yi pointed at the sack behind him and said, "This is my secret weapon. Put the sack on your back and let's go outside Shen Garden to find a place with better feng shui to bury the killer of Anjing Tower." He was not familiar with the terrain of Shen Garden and needed to survey the terrain first to find the most suitable place for an ambush.Xiao Di was shocked at that time. Is there really a secret weapon?I thought you were just showing off to my dad.Besides, what secret weapons can you make out of those bottles of wood, mercury and the like?He immediately entered the room with doubts and curiosity, opened the sack and took a look... As a result, bottles and jars were still bottles and jars. The difference was that Tang Yi combined them in a mess.Bottles and jars combined together become a secret weapon?!"Uh, brother, it's not that I don't believe it, but is this your secret weapon?" Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi, I don't read much, but don't treat me as a fool!"It's a weapon. Any bomb in here can break you to pieces. Do you want to try it?" Tang Yi squinted his eyes, a cold light flashing in his eyes.In his previous life, he was a top student at Northwestern Polytechnic and entered the army directly. It was easy for him to make a few bombs. In addition, during his time in the army and on missions, the total number of times he made bombs was estimated to be 8,000 times!I have become proficient in it already!So now he knows that these bombs can definitely explode without even testing them!If the hundred or ten bombs in the bag exploded at once, the entire Prince Yan's Mansion and even the surrounding houses would be razed to the ground.Xiao Di smelled a dangerous aura from Tang Yi and subconsciously crossed his legs. He always felt that this guy was looking for an opportunity to take revenge on him!Forget it, it's a matter of continuing the family lineage, so don't try it. If it really breaks down, it's nonsense."Ahem, there's no need for that. I'll just wait and see how you blow up the eggs in Anjinglou!" Xiao Di put the sack on his shoulder.A sack of secret weapons weighs more than a hundred kilograms, and Tang Yi is asked to carry it on his own?Haha, he couldn't walk more than three miles without vomiting blood.Hey, it’s all my fault for being too kind.He watched Sack step forward and put his arms around Tang Yi's waist.Tang Yi immediately jumped up as if he'd been electrocuted: "What are you doing? I'm not interested in men." "Oh, then just walk slowly to Shen Yuan!" Xiao Di glanced at Tang Yi, not understanding a kind heart.As soon as he stepped on the ground, his whole body instantly flew into the air, and then flipped in the air, easily gliding out of Prince Yan's Mansion.Tang Yi: "??" Damn it, cheating!I use the walking one, you use the flying one?!It’s twenty miles from Prince Yan’s Mansion to Shen Garden. It’s already dawn when we reach Shen Garden!And now that An Jinglou is watching him, it’s not safe to walk at night."Old Xiao, you have something to say." "I think men are pretty good, so don't be so polite." Tang Yi shouted and hurriedly chased him out....The next day, the Tang family.Early in the morning, the Tang family was already busy.In the Tang family hall, Tang Jing, Yan Shuangyu and her son, and Jiang Yunna were all gathered here to encourage Tang Hua.On the main seat, Tang Jing drank Tang Huajing's tea and looked at his gentle and gentle son standing in front of him. His face was full of relief and satisfaction."Don't worry about the celebration banquet. It's just a small setback on your way forward." When Tang Yi made a big fuss about the celebration banquet, the Tang family was embarrassed. Tang Jing was afraid that this incident would affect Tang Hua, so he smiled and enlightened him."Today, as long as you show the mentality you had during the imperial examination, you will win." "No matter what, I will overwhelm the entire audience to rectify the name of the Tang family for you and the Tang family." After Tang Yi made a big fuss at the celebration banquet, he has now become the laughing stock of Kyoto, and the story of Tang Jing's doting on his concubine and killing his wife has been brought out again.Now, he needs Tang Hua to win the first prize at the Shenyuan Poetry Society to prove that his original choice was correct.Tang Hua is his successor who was carefully cultivated by Tang Yi.And Tang Yi is just a loser who has some blood relationship with him!"Father, don't worry, the child will not disappoint his father." Tang Hua bowed his hands and said respectfully.He lowered his head at this time, and no one could see his face clearly. No one noticed that his face was extremely ferocious at this time, and the coldness in his eyes almost overflowed.Tang Yi, wait, I will pay you back the humiliation you brought me thousands of times today!"Master, don't worry. Hua'er has been serious these days and has been studying in his study." Yan Shuangyu walked out and looked at her handsome son with great satisfaction: "Hua'er is the number one scholar in three yuan and won the first prize today. I'm afraid countless girls in Kyoto are thinking about Hua'er." "Don't say Miss Kong, even a princess is not unmarried." Jiang Yunna glanced at Tang Hua secretly, her cheeks gradually turning red.What is a princess?Brother Hua can only be mine. Who else is worthy of such an outstanding son-in-law but me, Jiang Yunna?Tang Yi still wants to compete with Brother Hua, huh, how dare a firefly compete with the sun?Ridiculous!In the past few days, she originally wanted to use force against Tang Yi directly and then frame Tang Yi, but it was a pity that he had been hiding in Prince Yan's palace and never had the chance.Otherwise, he would have been ruined by now!"That's right, my brother is now the number one talent in Kyoto. He is many times better than that little poet who hides his head and shows his tail."
